the meeting in the following ways:

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
852 9904 1876, Meeting Password: 339794. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call-in
option from a phone line.)

- Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos”
page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an “eComment”
button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp page. After
you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen by the
public, will be considered by the Committee and become part of the record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store), by
entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 852 9904 1876, Meeting Password: 339794. Members of the public

joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the lower portion of your
screen. The Meeting Host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you would like to
speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the City's
website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city/agendas.

REGULAR EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
  MINUTES
  October 25, 2021

A regular meeting of the Equestrian Committee of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
called to order by CHAIR HUFF at 7:02 P.M. via teleconference, pursuant to the
Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20.
Committee Members Present:  Huff, Brtis, Shinn, Ciarolla, Griggs, Nilsen, Zigrang
Committee Members Absent:  Harik, Silvano, Robinson, Martin
City Staff Present:  Assistant City Manager, Alexa Davis
  Community Services Supervisor, Rosa Pinuelas
  Management Analyst, Jessica Slawson
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  MEMBER CIAROLLA moved, seconded by MEMBER GRIGGS, to:
  APPROVE THE DRAFT MINUTES OF THE AUGUST 23, 2021
  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING AS PRESENTED.
  and
  APPROVE THE DRAFT MINUTES OF THE SEPTEMBER 27, 2021
  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING AS PRESENTED.
There being no objection, CHAIR HUFF so ordered.
AUDIENCE ITEMS WRITTEN /ORAL COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON AGENDA
None.
STAFF ITEMS
A.  EQUESTRIAN EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS (VERBAL REPORT)
Management Analyst Slawson provided a report that the Equine Emergency
Preparedness Subcommittee met on October 11, 2021 to discuss installing water caches
at strategic locations for horses throughout the City with next steps to work
with maintenance in addressing logistics and security which will return to the Committee
before implementation. She further explained the new equestrian alert notification
system available to the community and information regarding how to register has been
made available at equestrian message boards throughout the City, to the Palos Verdes
Peninsula Horsemen’s Association and through City events. She discussed that the
system provides arena and trail updates as well as emergency alerts.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
OCTOBER 25, 2021
  1
 Management Analyst Slawson also reported that the City’s website is updated to reflect
important equine emergency resources with local vet and other emergency preparedness
resources.

She further reported that the Prepared Peninsula Expo, held Sunday October 24, hosted
the Los Angeles County Animal Control / Equine Response Team. She looks forward to
working with them to hold a future microchipping clinic and other trainings. She
additionally reported that she is researching City and County partnerships for sheltering
surveys in the City/Peninsula and off the Peninsula for emergency horse evacuations and
sheltering needs.

COMMITTEE MEMBER SHINN thanked Management Analyst Slawson for her great job
in equine emergency preparedness and looks forward to continued progress this next
year.

CHAIR HUFF asked if microchipping horses helps identify horses in the instance one is
displaced in an emergency. Management Analyst Slawson affirmed and stated that she
is looking forward to partnering with the County in the future to hold this event again as it
was successful in the past.

B.  NOVEMBER MEETING PROPOSED DATE (VERBAL REPORT)

ACM Davis asked the Committee if the November meeting date could be rescheduled to
Monday, November 29 in consideration of the Thanksgiving Holiday week. All Committee
members were in agreement.

C.  EQUESTRIAN ISSUES LOG
No questions or further issues reported.
COMMITTEE REPORTS

A.  TRAIL (VERBAL REPORT)

COMMITTEE MEMBER BRTIS asked if there could be signage installed at Lariat trail
from Rolling Hills Road reminding that no motorized vehicles or bicycles are permitted on
the trail as there has been increased usage in the area.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

A.  AMBASSADOR PROGRAM

This item will come back to the Committee with more details.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
OCTOBER 25, 2021
  2
 B. TRAIL RIDING OPERATION PERMIT REVIEW

An update will be provided at the November meeting.

Assistant City Manager Davis shared that the Riding Ring Rules request to temporarily
modify Chandler Arena restrictions will be presented to the City Council at their November
9, 2021 meeting.

COMMITTEE MEMBER SHINN asked that staff provide an update on the Chandler Park
playground discussion at the next meeting.

CHAIR HUFF adjourned the Equestrian Committee meeting 7:20 P.M.

Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

__________________________  __________________________
Alexa Davis  Britt Huff, Chair
Assistant City Manager
